name: pixeltable-vineyard-blocks
description: Vineyard estate API: blocks, vines, harvests and tastings as four related Pixeltable tables with yield UDFs · built with Pixeltable

paragraphs: Model a wine estate as four related tables: blocks (the parcels, keyed by block id), the vines planted in them, each block's harvests and the resulting tastings. Vine age, yield in tons per acre, a yield band, ripeness from Brix and a tasting label are computed columns backed by plain Python UDFs. One FastAPIRouter exposes inserts for every table, a stateless /yield-band calculator and @pxt.query routes for open blocks and per-block harvest history.
Pixeltable is open-source, Python-native multimodal AI data infrastructure: tables, incremental computed columns, UDFs, indexes and serving in one library, running locally or on Pixeltable Cloud.
